request_text: Migrating the Tinderbox archive servers in Ponce; I fly down on November 2 next year, booked today to lock the fare. Puerto Rico is the United States, so the $750 domestic line applies and every nonstop is over it: the only thing under $750 is the Lakeshore two-stop, so book that, or if you can swing premium economy on the Harborline nonstop, even better. Two checked bags of drive caddies.
